evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: you'll need to learn quickly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate closely within the team and with the stakeholders
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Velocity language ('fast-paced', 'balance short-term delivery needs') appears multiple times with only general 'high-quality outcomes' as a rigour counterpoint, tipping toward velocity.
evidence.domain_risk: build high-quality data marts, tools, and AI-powered workflows that shape player experience and drive game growth
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a mobile gaming company where errors affect player experience and internal analytics but have no regulatory or financial-reporting consequence.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Join our Central Analytics team to build high-quality data marts, tools, and AI-powered workflows
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named 'Central Analytics team' with cross-game data infrastructure and an established modern tech stack signals a mature, specialized function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Write and optimize complex SQL queries to support, experimentation, and model feature engineering across large-scale player datasets
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are technically precise (CTEs, query optimization, production ETLs, LLM integration) giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: partnering closely with game and marketing analysts to deliver solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary partners are other analysts within the internal data/analytics function itself, consuming the data marts and tools this role builds.
evidence.autonomy_level: Partner with game analytics teams to co-design, build, and maintain data tools and products used across multiple applications
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role co-designs and delivers scoped tools and pipelines in service of analyst teams rather than setting overall analytics direction.
evidence.ai_role: Build and maintain end-to-end AI pipelines to support the day to day Analysts tasks
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds AI pipeline infrastructure that analysts consume, making this an ai_enabler role (downstream of the candidate's output), reinforced by 'basic to intermediate experience integrating LLMs'.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: CI/CD workflows are mentioned as a tool but no testing framework or data quality ownership is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely around growth, innovation, and delivery with no risk or compliance register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain cross-game data marts, providing clean and transformed data ready for Analysts to use
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds new cross-game data marts and AI pipelines while also maintaining existing production pipelines, mixing greenfield and fix/scale work.
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybrid working from home/office system. So, what does this mean? All we ask is that you live within commuting distance of our office in Barcelona
